evidence: Searched the reply (lines 1-14), the new mini-doc docs/design/exportacao-de-relatorios-armazenamento-s3.md (all lines) and the two changed header lines of docs/design/exportacao-de-relatorios.md (lines 9-10) for asserted costs, retention, credentials/access, download mechanism/URL, metrics, change date, outcomes and alternatives not established by the user or the original doc.
